failure_summary.description: Agents rebuilt or redundantly filtered cached scopes instead of using the most constrained compatible result and applying only new constraints.
Agents did not reliably search for a newly requested specific entity or combine compatible attraction criteria into one search.
An ambiguous location reference was not resolved from trip context, and a complete independent search was skipped while other domains lacked dates.
A search result was not assigned and saved; the cache received the tool function instead of its returned result.
The agent did not preserve the full requested neighborhood wording and supplied a flight constraint that did not match the expected call.

patch.reasoning: Most cache, combined-attraction, and result-binding failures already contradict explicit skill rules, so duplicating those rules is unlikely to close a skill gap. Add only a concise clarification for resolving an unambiguous deictic destination in a newly requested independent domain.

edits.content: - Resolve an unambiguous location reference such as “there” from the established trip destination. If the user also requests an independent domain whose mandatory inputs are available, search and save that scope even while seeking missing mandatory details for other pending domains.
